verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app. A product of this kind could plausibly offer natural-language or voice command control, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only touch, trackpad, keyboard, Apple Pencil and IME text input; nothing shows the product interpreting natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
